description: This file contains utility functions for handling default values, JSON encoding/decoding, and value checks, part of the 'sprig' package used for templating.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Seeds the random number generator with current time.

methods.name: dfault
methods.description: Returns default value if 'given' is unset or empty; otherwise returns 'given'.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if a value is the zero value for its type.

methods.name: coalesce
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty value from the list.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns true if all values are non-empty.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns true if any value is non-empty.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into a value, ignoring errors.

methods.name: mustFromJson
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into a value, returning errors.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Encodes a value into a JSON string.

methods.name: mustToJson
methods.description: Encodes a value into a JSON string, returning errors.

methods.name: toPrettyJson
methods.description: Encodes a value into a pretty-printed JSON string.

methods.name: mustToPrettyJson
methods.description: Encodes a value into a pretty-printed JSON string, returning errors.

methods.name: toRawJson
methods.description: Encodes a value into a JSON string with no HTML escaping.

methods.name: mustToRawJson
methods.description: Encodes a value into a JSON string with no HTML escaping, returning errors.

methods.name: ternary
methods.description: Returns 'vt' if 'v' is true; otherwise returns 'vf'.
